emptyValue: This value must not be empty
invalidChoice: This value is not one of the available choices
invalidColor: This value must be an opaque hex color like `#ff8800`
invalidColorAlpha: This value must be a hex color like `#ff8800` or `#ff880080`
invalidDate: This value must be a calendar date in `YYYY-MM-DD` form
invalidEmail: This value must be an email address like `thrall@orgrimmar.example`
invalidLink: This link must be a web, email or phone address, a `/path` or a `#fragment`
invalidReference: The referenced record does not exist
invalidTime: This value must be a time of day in `HH:MM:SS` form
invalidURL: This value must be a public web address like `https://orgrimmar.example`
maxDepth: Lists may nest at most {max, plural, one {# level} other {# levels}} deep
maxItems: This list must hold at most {max, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}
maxLength: This value must be at most {max, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} long
maxValue: This value must be at most `{max}`
minItems: This list must hold at least {min, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}
minLength: This value must be at least {min, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} long
minValue: This value must be at least `{min}`
notNullable: This field does not accept null
singleParagraph: This value holds a single paragraph
singleRecord: Item updates address a single record
